# Signal Hunt — federation investigation game & educational lab

Signal Hunt is a federation-native investigation game and an educational laboratory over real AIMarket Hub telemetry. The player observes a measured symptom, opens committed evidence, commits a diagnosis with confidence, and receives a reproducible Brier-score verdict. There is no seeded anomaly feed and no `ArenaHub` class — Signal Hunt Hub is an ordinary AIMarket Hub.

Treat each round as a lab exercise wrapped in a hunt: the curriculum is live federation literacy (manifest, sources, prices, peer roster, latency probes, provenance), evidence cost, calibrated confidence, cryptographic verification and detector thresholds — including `peer_churn` and `latency_weather`. Entertainment keeps attention; measured Hub data is the syllabus. Terminology follows `docs/localization-glossary.md` (Signal Hunt section).
